methods: Two independently seeded evaluation cohorts. The unit is the paired controller seed within physical host and recorded lane. Percentile intervals resample those pairs within stratum. TH11 uses settled native score; TH12 uses fatal Stage 1 tick; TH10, TH13 and TH17 use last observed native Stage 1 tick. All 320 arm outcomes are verified Game Over in Stage 1. Differences across generations use distinct seed sets. This is descriptive and does not correct for multiple comparisons.
